[[Image:Wr hc e1m2.gif]]

"Played on a danish server. Norpan got gl and killed their quad. No one really got a good grip on ya/gl, though we got a couple of more ya's than them... and then we won. / WR^Liech & WR^norpan"
=== DM3 === WR: 102 - HC: 120
[[Image:Wr hc dm3.gif]]

"Played on a uk server. Norpan got the first rl and secured ra in the beginning, but lost while he was hunting rockets. They got most of the pents, the first one included, and had ya and ra under their control. We got a couple of rl's here and there, but with no armor we couldn't do much. Liech managed to take back RA and got a few quads. One of them timed out (+20 frags in the sshot), so we got a few extra frags meanwhile, but they still held the quadside strong, one of their hpw players who was spectating jumped in and helped them. They won the map with [18] points. / WR^Liech & WR^norpan"
=== DM2 === WR: 263 - HC: 56
[[Image:Wr hc dm2.gif]]

"Again played on a danish server, since it was the most equal one. they got the first quad, but BoneCrusher, who got low rl, managed to pick him out. He then secured low rl for almost the entire game while the rest of us was struggling to gain control over the teleport and quad. It would've been more even if we could have found a server somewhere in the water, where is Atlantis when you need it? / WR^Liech & WR^norpan"
